baseline.note: engine-output baseline from rs-engine and hsi-engine; Eureka was substrate_unavailable on the bare fixtures

rule: adopt an arm only if wilson95(useful, shown)[0] > 0.448 on each of 3 repeats

definitions.useful_rate: gold-useful share of the pairs an arm shows (recall arms) or passes (judge arms), labeled blind by the navigator with scripts/label-355-gold.cjs on the pairings-unstamped set
definitions.passes: stage-a: Stage A gate passes; jev: choice is useful (Stage A runs first inside the judge); claude: verdict is useful (all pairs, no Stage A); claude-then-jev: Jev choice is useful over Claude's useful subset only
definitions.repeats: recall arms are deterministic so the three repeats are recorded as identical runs; judge arms jev, claude and claude-then-jev run three times each
definitions.comparability: every arm reports its shown count n beside the rate; an arm with n below the baseline n of 96 is flagged n_below_baseline_n in the record and the navigator rules on comparability at 366-20
definitions.slice_rule: rs-graph and hsi-graph are also read against the RS slice (16 of 49) and the HSI slice (27 of 47) of the baseline; slice figures are reported, they do not gate the bar

vector_lane.source: local embeddings only (lib/core/eureka/embedding-spine.cjs), cross-section cosine top-k per thing, no similarity floor
vector_lane.requires: a cached local model; with none cached the arm exits 77 (ENV GAP) and never downloads

out_of_scope: Q2 known-ness and Q4 research-lift arms of design section 9 are not in D-05; the navigator may add them at the 366-20 ruling
